about: A labelled, made-up inbox for a fictional small bakery (Harbor Lane Bakery). Every address is on example.com. Written by hand alongside the rules, so it is a regression suite for known hard cases, not an unbiased sample: measure on your own labelled mail before trusting stage trash.
